compiled_state.title: ticket-init.sh: git worktree add >/dev/null 2>&1 silences real git errors silently
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: The change from 2>/dev/null to >/dev/null 2>&1 on git worktree add calls suppresses both the 'HEAD is now at...' progress output (intended) and any real error messages from git (side effect). Callers have no visibility into failures from branch-already-checked-out or permission errors. Acceptable for now because surrounding code handles failure via worktree prune/rm fallback, but could make debugging harder.
File: plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-init.sh
